title: Capacity and cost
objectives: Say what a capacity unit (CU) measures
Find what used most of the capacity in a period
Show each item's share so the biggest win is obvious

exercises.prompt: From cu_usage, return the three items that used the most CU-seconds from 26 October to 1 November 2026 (inclusive): item, cu_seconds, and share_pct, their percent of that week's total rounded to 1 decimal place, largest first.
hints: The starter adds up every day ever recorded and has no share.
Filter day >= DATE '2026-10-26' AND day < DATE '2026-11-02' before adding up.
Work out the week's total per item in a CTE, then round(100.0 * cu_seconds / (SELECT sum(cu_seconds) FROM week), 1).
